tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Fuzzy-find files by path in a folder, best match first. Respects .gitignore. Returns each file's path, score and the matched character ranges.

query.description: Part of a file name or path, e.g. `mcp tools`

folder.description: The folder to search, an absolute path (e.g. the repo's root); the working directory when omitted

git.description: Rank files with uncommitted changes and recently committed files higher, the way an editor's quick-open does; default false

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search the contents of a folder's files with ripgrep. Respects .gitignore; skips hidden and binary files. Returns each matching file with its matching lines (1-based) and match ranges; `truncated` marks where the search stopped.

query.description: A literal string, or a regex when `regex` is true

folder.description: The folder to search, an absolute path (e.g. the repo's root); the working directory when omitted

globs.description: ripgrep globs limiting the files; a leading `!` excludes

tools.name: search_structural
tools.description: Search a folder's code by syntax with an ast-grep pattern, e.g. `console.log($A)`. Respects .gitignore. Returns each matching file with its matching lines and match ranges, as search_text does.

pattern.description: An ast-grep pattern; `$A` matches one node

folder.description: The folder to search, an absolute path (e.g. the repo's root); the working directory when omitted

lang.description: The pattern's language; each file's own, from its extension, when omitted

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: Every file in a folder that ripgrep would search: .gitignore respected, hidden files skipped. Paths in no particular order; `truncated` when cut at the limit.

folder.description: The folder to search, an absolute path (e.g. the repo's root); the working directory when omitted

tools.name: search_sessions
tools.description: Search this machine's Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode conversations for a phrase in what was said (prompts, answers, tool calls and output), newest first. Returns each session's harness, id, title, last write and up to 3 matching snippets.

query.description: A literal phrase, not a regex

folder.description: Only sessions run in this folder (an absolute path, e.g. the repo's root); every folder's when omitted
